test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and select the correct option.

i) The Governor is the real head of the State Government.

ii) The Chief Minister plays a key role in framing the laws and policies of the state government.

iii) The Governor of a State is appointed by the President.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Both ii and iii**__.

• **The Governor is the nominal head not the real head** of the** State Government.**
 
• They make decisions based on the advice of the **Chief Minister **and their council of ministers.
